clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: BOQ Title IT Equipment /MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: MSE bidders get no relaxation from the experience criteria.

clauses.heading: MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover
clauses.quote: BOQ Title IT Equipment /MSE Relaxation for Years of Experience and Turnover No
clauses.summary: MSE bidders get no relaxation from the turnover criteria.

clauses.heading: Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience
clauses.quote: Startup Relaxation for Years Of Experience Yes Complete /Document required from seller Experience Criteria
clauses.summary: Startups get complete relaxation from the years-of-experience requirement.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)
clauses.summary: Bidders must upload documents proving the experience criteria.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: Document required from seller Experience Criteria,Certificate (Requested in ATC),OEM Authorization Certificate,Additional Doc 1 (Requested in ATC)
clauses.summary: Bidders must upload an OEM Authorization Certificate.

clauses.heading: Document required from seller
clauses.quote: In case any bidder is seeking exemption from Experience / Turnover Criteria, the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for exemption must be uploaded for evaluation by the buyer
clauses.summary: Bidders seeking exemption from experience or turnover criteria must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: EMD Detail
clauses.quote: EMD Detail M /Advisory Bank State Bank of India /EMD Amount 3169000
clauses.summary: An EMD of Rs 31,69,000 is required.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: The bidder seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant category as per GeM GTC with the bid.
clauses.summary: Bidders claiming EMD exemption must submit valid supporting documents for their category with the bid.

clauses.heading: EMD EXEMPTION
clauses.quote: Under MSE category, only manufacturers for goods and Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy.
clauses.summary: Only MSE manufacturers (goods) or service providers qualify for EMD exemption; traders do not.

clauses.heading: (c)
clauses.quote: Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) shall also be accepted by the buyer in the form of a surety bond.
clauses.summary: EMD may also be submitted as a surety bond.

clauses.quote: If the bidder is a DPIIT registered Startup, the bidder shall be relaxed from eligibility criteria of "Experience Criteria" as defined above subject to their meeting of quality and technical specifications.
clauses.summary: DPIIT-registered startups are relaxed from the experience criteria if they meet quality and technical specifications.

clauses.quote: The bidder seeking Relaxation from Experience Criteria, shall upload the supporting documents to prove his eligibility for Relaxation.
clauses.summary: Startups seeking experience relaxation must upload supporting documents proving eligibility.

clauses.heading: 5 Forms of EMD and PBG
clauses.quote: Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited
clauses.summary: EMD may also be paid online via RTGS or internet banking to ONGC.
